architecture.engine: bundled Python: pymavlink, NumPy, SciPy, PyArrow
architecture.ipc: versioned framed stdio via narrow Rust commands
architecture.default_network: offline except explicitly configured LAN sources / user-opened references
platforms: macOS x64 if supported by release target matrix
architecture.version_policy: Select and lock tested versions during packaging spike; pin firmware adapters, parser and algorithm revisions.

non_negotiables: Original logs and protected tune baselines are immutable.
Every number/finding traces to source hash, instance, field, time scope, parser and rule version.
Missing/unsupported/stale is not zero, healthy or a physical fault.
Raw, measured post-filter and simulated post-filter data are distinct.
No VIBE-to-FFT inference; no current-only PID prescription.
No automatic aircraft parameter writes, flight commands, log erase or firmware update.
No unrelated vehicle, boot epoch, battery monitor or flight merging.
No required cloud upload or user-installed Python/Node runtime.
No dummy data outside explicitly labeled synthetic demo/test context.
No silent numerical threshold copied across firmware/hardware profiles.

entities.name: AircraftProfileVersion
entities.required_contents: Aircraft ID; board/firmware identity; physical motor map; ESC instance mapping evidence; motors/props/battery; calibration status; hardware changes; limits and their provenance.

entities.name: FlightSession
entities.required_contents: UUID; aircraft profile version; operator/test notes; mass/payload/battery/weather; actual parameter snapshots; source IDs; proposed and confirmed flight intervals.

entities.name: SourceManifest
entities.required_contents: Original name/location; SHA-256; byte size; device and software identity; acquisition method; start/end clocks; parser version; success/partial/error status; warnings.

entities.name: SignalSchema
entities.required_contents: Source message/field; physical quantity; raw and engineering units; scaling provenance; sensor/ESC/system/component instance; expected and observed cadence; sentinels.

entities.name: Sample / event
entities.required_contents: Source ID; boot epoch; source sequence/message offset; raw time; time domain; normalized time if valid; value or null; quality flags.

entities.name: TimeAlignment
entities.required_contents: Source and target clocks; anchor pairs; affine/piecewise transform; offset/drift; fit residuals; uncertainty; confidence; user adjustments and provenance.

entities.name: MetricResult
entities.required_contents: Algorithm/version; interval and phase; value/unit; count and time coverage; exclusions; uncertainty; source/field references; interpretation limits.

entities.name: Finding
entities.required_contents: Rule/version; severity; evidence quality; confidence; observation; competing hypotheses; evidence intervals; next action; expected result; parameter applicability; retest criteria.

entities.name: ParameterSnapshot / proposal
entities.required_contents: Immutable original; parsed values; firmware metadata; before/after diff; reason; target aircraft; validation status; rollback snapshot; no implicit application.

entities.name: Experiment / issue
entities.required_contents: Baseline and candidate; one functional change; confounders; planned success criteria; repetitions; results; open/investigating/retest/resolved history.

entities.name: CollectionJob
entities.required_contents: Per-adapter state/progress; resumable transfer position; retries; chosen flight grouping; missing-data consequences and recovery instructions.

rules.name: Source identity and schema
rules.algorithm_requirement: Identify firmware, schema, vehicle and source before semantic decoding.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Unknown identity/units => partial assessment; never silently apply another build's scale.

rules.name: Recording completeness
rules.inputs: DSF, cadence, parser status, byte ranges
rules.algorithm_requirement: Measure missing/corrupt/truncated intervals and logger rejection deltas.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Mark affected results partial; missing messages do not establish healthy operation.

rules.name: Clock validity
rules.algorithm_requirement: Split epochs and estimate transform with residual/uncertainty.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No cross-source ordering or causal claims below clock uncertainty.

rules.name: Vibration exposure
rules.inputs: VIBE by IMU and axis; phase
rules.algorithm_requirement: Quantiles, time exposure and longest exceedance at 30/60 m/s² guidance bands.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Separate persistent airborne vibration from takeoff/landing impacts.

rules.name: Clipping episodes
rules.algorithm_requirement: Reset/wrap-aware increments per sensor, preserving unknown initial history.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Unknown event timing across a gap; mechanical review before tuning persistent clipping.

rules.name: IMU health and disagreement
rules.algorithm_requirement: Track new errors, sensor changes and paired disagreement.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Different orientation/scale or missing health data blocks sensor-fault attribution.

rules.name: Spectrum eligibility
rules.inputs: GYR or valid ISBH/ISBD raw samples
rules.algorithm_requirement: Validate scale, timing, continuity, sample rate, pre/post identity and Nyquist.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Reject VIBE-as-FFT, missing batches and unsupported provenance.

rules.name: Noise orders and notch candidate
rules.inputs: Gyro spectra, RPM lineage, filter chain/params
rules.algorithm_requirement: Identify persistent ridges/orders; model attenuation and delay using matching firmware.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No numeric notch candidate with unknown RPM scale, stale data, aliasing or filter topology.

rules.name: Rate/attitude tracking
rules.algorithm_requirement: Error, lag, bias, quantiles, valid-step or identified response with uncertainty.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No universal tuning score; invalid excitation or saturation suppresses gain inference.

rules.name: PID contribution diagnosis
rules.algorithm_requirement: Evaluate I accumulation/recovery, D noise association and limiter activity.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Large I/D terms alone do not prove windup or wrong gains.

rules.name: Actuator authority
rules.inputs: Motor mapping, RCOU, MOTB/PID flags, output protocol
rules.algorithm_requirement: Match limit episodes and output demand to tracking loss.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Output number is not physical thrust; absent protocol/limits blocks saturation claims.

rules.name: Energy and phase power
rules.inputs: Primary physical battery V/I, counters, phase
rules.algorithm_requirement: Signed trapezoidal integration; gap-aware coverage; compare valid counters.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Never sum aggregate/component duplicate monitors; partial Wh must remain labeled partial.

rules.name: Battery limits and voltage demand
rules.inputs: Calibrated pack/cell signals, chemistry, configured thresholds
rules.algorithm_requirement: Evaluate applicable voltage/current/thermal limits and dwell with actual source selection.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No universal 12S chemistry limits or cell-balance inference from pack voltage.

rules.name: Efficiency and endurance scenario
rules.algorithm_requirement: Matched hover/cruise metrics and scenario estimates with reserve/uncertainty.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No causal PID-energy claim from one flight or unsupported nominal capacity.

rules.name: ESC channel freshness
rules.algorithm_requirement: Completeness and sample-age checks per expected instance/channel.
rules.abstention_or_limit: RPM-only presence cannot establish temperature/current coverage.
spec_sections: 15  ESCs, motors, airframe and power distribution

rules.name: Motor asymmetry and response
rules.algorithm_requirement: Detect persistent matched-condition differences and abrupt response changes.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Preserve allocation/wind/calibration alternatives; no unique fault cause from imbalance alone.
spec_sections: 15  ESCs, motors, airframe and power distribution

rules.name: GNSS quality
rules.algorithm_requirement: Fix/accuracy/cadence/correction transitions and estimator impact.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No position trust or interference-source conclusion from satellites/jam indicator alone.
spec_sections: 16  Navigation, heading, altitude and controller health

rules.name: Estimator consistency
rules.inputs: Lane-specific XKF/NKF status, innovation tests, sensor sources
rules.algorithm_requirement: Identify excursions, resets, timeouts, lane/aiding changes.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Use exact transformed metric semantics; a ratio crossing is not the complete failsafe logic.
spec_sections: 16  Navigation, heading, altitude and controller health

rules.name: Heading/compass interference
rules.inputs: MAG, yaw innovations, source/orientation and current
rules.algorithm_requirement: Controlled heading/field comparisons and current-associated residuals.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No copied offsets or interference percentage derived from an unrelated regression.
spec_sections: 16  Navigation, heading, altitude and controller health

rules.name: Altitude/trajectory response
rules.algorithm_requirement: Compare requested, shaped target and achieved motion with reset/frame handling.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Mission upload/ACK is not execution or completion.
spec_sections: 16  Navigation, heading, altitude and controller health

rules.name: Power rails and resets
rules.algorithm_requirement: Review new flags and measured rail/temperature excursions.
rules.abstention_or_limit: An abrupt log ending is not proof of brownout; low-rate data misses transients.
spec_sections: 16  Navigation, heading, altitude and controller health

rules.name: Scheduler and logging load
rules.algorithm_requirement: Properly scaled load, long-loop counts, memory and dropped-log episodes.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Do not use a universal raw Load or rail threshold.
spec_sections: 16  Navigation, heading, altitude and controller health

rules.name: Control path / failsafe reconstruction
rules.algorithm_requirement: Reconstruct per-system request, receipt, acceptance and observed response.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No RF-loss attribution from sequence gaps; ACK is not physical completion.
spec_sections: 17  Radio, GCS, joystick and video troubleshooting

rules.name: RF diagnostics and capture health
rules.inputs: Both radios raw/normalized records with verified units/windows
rules.algorithm_requirement: Separate API failure, missing samples and RF observations; deduplicate known rolling history.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Unknown timestamp/units => raw archive only; expired unrecorded history is unrecoverable.
spec_sections: 17  Radio, GCS, joystick and video troubleshooting

rules.name: GCS/video observation path
rules.algorithm_requirement: Correlate freezes/drops/load and control-stream health with clock uncertainty.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Ping or video file alone does not measure glass-to-glass latency.
spec_sections: 17  Radio, GCS, joystick and video troubleshooting

rules.name: Configuration and baseline diff
rules.inputs: Actual per-flight snapshots plus parameter timeline
rules.algorithm_requirement: Version-aware changed/added/removed values and hardware/calibration-specific fields.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Never overwrite protected baselines or assume final parameters applied to the whole flight.

rules.name: Experiment result and regression
rules.inputs: Repeated matched baseline/candidate flights and acceptance criteria
rules.algorithm_requirement: Flight/segment-aware comparison with uncertainty and multi-objective constraints.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No success label with confounded conditions or unacceptable tracking/thermal/health regression.

rules.name: Observer freshness and alert state
rules.inputs: Source time progression, receipt age, recorder/engine status
rules.algorithm_requirement: Per-channel staleness, dwell/hysteresis, clear/recur and post-flight reconciliation.
rules.abstention_or_limit: A stale dashboard is not an all-clear; acknowledgement is not resolution.

acceptance_families.scenarios: Duplicate bytes, duplicate filenames with different bytes, two vehicles in one TLOG, multiple flights in one file, wrong profile and unknown firmware.
Older/newer VIBE formats; fixed-point scale applied once; missing/sentinel values; corrupt/truncated records; unknown units; very large input.
FC reboot, counter wrap, PC wall-clock jump, drift, invalid UTC, delayed TLOG delivery and radio time with unknown epoch.
Known constant/ramp power; long gaps; negative current; partial windows; battery-monitor duplication; clipping counters starting nonzero/resetting.
Known sine/noise, missing batch, irregular sampling, aliasing, pre/post provenance; valid/rejected steps; saturation and low-excitation cases.
One missing ESC/RPM/temperature channel; stale values; unsupported sensor; partial log; enough data to plot but insufficient to recommend.
Busy port, armed aircraft, growing log, byte gap, disconnect/resume, changed remote log, bad radio JSON, failed poll, overlapping RF windows, disk full.
Inspect every outbound controller message; no arming, mode, mission, parameter writes or log deletion. Read-only source failure cannot stop the controlling GCS.
Fresh install, offline mode, crash/restart, profile revision, immutable baselines, report reproduction, keyboard/200% zoom and clear synthetic data.
Recorder overload, UI crash, stale telemetry, duplicate timestamps, app sleep/resume, alert clear/recur and post-flight revision of a hypothesis.
Representative Cube and H7 logs; four mapped APD ESCs; both SkyPulse responses; actual GCS forwarding; SIYI capability probe.
Matched trials improve known synthetic metrics; confounded payload/wind/time scope blocks causal improvement claims.
